# 🧩 The Components V2 starter kit
A hands-on tour of every block DWEEB gives you — and it's all live. **Click any component on the left to edit it**, watch the preview update instantly, then hit **Send** or **Share** when it looks right.
**Sections** set a short stack of text beside a single accessory. Pair one with a **thumbnail** — like this — for profile cards, product shots, and tidy call-outs.
Give a section a **button** instead and the same layout becomes an action card: a headline, a line of detail, and one tappable action docked on the right.

items.description: Media galleries hold up to 10 images or clips
Give every item its own description…
…or mark any one of them as a spoiler

components.content:
**Every text block speaks full Discord markdown.**
Blend **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, ~~strikethrough~~, `inline code`, and ||spoilers|| — each renders exactly as Discord shows it. Drop in [masked links](https://dweeb.faizo.net), lists, and quotes wherever you need them:
> Good messages look effortless. DWEEB just makes effortless easy.
**There's even more in the box** — dropdown menus, clickable (non-link) buttons, and file uploads are all one tap away in the **Add component** menu.

-# 💡 **Posts through any webhook:** text, layout, media, and link buttons. Interactive pieces — clickable buttons and select menus — need a **bot or app** to own the webhook; a plain user webhook will reject them.
-# Reopen this tour any time from the **Template Gallery**, or hit **Reset** (top-left) to start fresh.

# 👋 Welcome to the server!
We're really glad you found us. Here's everything you need to settle in.

**Get started in three steps**
- 📜 Read the **#rules** so everyone stays on the same page
- 🎭 Pick up your roles in **#get-roles**
- 💬 Say hi and introduce yourself in **#general**
Stuck on anything? A friendly mod is only a message away.
-# Glad to have you — enjoy your stay! 💜

# 📢 Announcement
**A quick heads-up for everyone** — here's what's new and what it means for you.

We just rolled out a big update — faster, cleaner, and packed with the features you asked for. Skim the highlights, then dive in:
- 🚀 Noticeably faster across the board
- 🎨 A fresh new look
- 🛠️ Dozens of fixes and tweaks
-# Posted by the team • Thanks for being part of the community 💜
This week we're celebrating **@artist** for their incredible series above. Drop a 💜 to show some love, and tag us to be featured next!
-# Want the spotlight? Post in #showcase with the tag #feature-me.

### Friday, June 20 · 8:00 PM ET
Jump into voice for a relaxed evening of party games. All skill levels welcome — bring a friend!

**📍 Where:** Game Night voice channel
**🎮 Playing:** Jackbox, Gartic Phone & more
**👥 Spots:** Unlimited
-# RSVP grants the Attendee role so we can ping everyone who's coming — tap again to bow out. Set a role expiry and it cleans itself up after the event.

### 🎁 {prize}
Tap **Enter** below — the count ticks up live and a fair winner is drawn on its own.

# 🗂️ Server Directory
One message to find anything in **{server}** — channels, roles, and members. Pick from a menu and your results come back **privately**, with clickable mentions to jump straight there.
**🧭 Channels** — find a place to read, post, or hop into voice.
**🎭 Roles** — look up a role and who carries it.
**👋 Members** — search for a member or staffer.
**🔎 Find anything** — not sure what it is? Search members and roles together.
-# Wire each menu to the Picker plugin — every result is private to whoever searched. Pick up to five at a time.

# 🛟 Help Center
Everything in one place — grab an instant answer, or open a private ticket with the team.
**⚡ Instant answers** — the questions we get every day, answered on the spot.

# 📜 Server Rules
Welcome! Being here means you agree to follow these.

**1.** Be respectful — no harassment, hate speech, or discrimination.
**2.** Keep it civil — no spam, flooding, or wall-to-wall caps.
**3.** Use the right channels and stay on topic.
**4.** No NSFW, gore, or illegal content.
**5.** No unsolicited advertising or DM spam.
**6.** Follow staff direction — their word is final.
> Breaking the rules may lead to a warning, mute, kick, or ban depending on severity.
-# Last updated June 2026 • Questions? Ask a moderator.

# 🧭 Find your way around
A quick map of where everything lives.

**🚪 Start here**
**#welcome** — you are here
**#rules** — the house rules
**#announcements** — important updates

**💬 Hang out**
**#general** — everyday chatter
**#introductions** — say hello
**#media** — share your pics & clips

**🛟 Need help?**
**#support** — open a ticket
**#faq** — answers to common questions
-# Tip: long-press (or right-click) any channel to mute or favourite it.

# 💡 Suggestion Box
Got an idea to make **{server}** better? We want to hear it — big or small.

**What makes a great suggestion**
- 🎯 One idea per submission
- 📝 Say what problem it solves
- 🔍 Check it hasn't been suggested already
-# The button opens a pop-up form — your idea goes straight to the team, and you get a private confirmation.

# 🙋 Introduce yourself!
New here? Tap the button below, fill in a quick form, and your intro posts right here so everyone can say hi.

**We'd love to know**
- 🙂 Your name or nickname
- 🌍 Where you're from
- ✨ What brought you here
- 🎯 A hobby or what you're currently into
-# The button opens a quick pop-up form — don't be shy, everyone started with their first message. 😊

# 🛡️ Join the team
**{server}** is growing and we're looking for moderators and helpers to keep it awesome.

**What we look for**
- 🕒 Active a few hours a week
- 🤝 Calm, fair, and friendly under pressure
- 🧠 Knows the rules inside out

**What you get**
- 🛡️ The staff role and badge
- 🔧 Access to staff channels and tools
- 💜 A real say in where the server goes
-# Applying opens a pop-up questionnaire that goes straight to the review team — one application per person.

### ✨ New
- Added dark-mode dashboards
- You can now pin up to 10 favourites

### 🔧 Improved
- 30% faster load times
- Cleaner mobile layout

### 🐛 Fixed
- Notifications no longer double-fire
- Squashed a rare crash on export

**How do I get roles?**
Head to **#get-roles** and pick from the menu — they apply instantly.

**How do I report someone?**
Open a ticket in **#support** or DM a moderator with details.

**Can I promote my own stuff?**
Only in **#self-promo**, and please keep it occasional.

**I found a bug — where do I post it?**
Drop it in **#feedback** with steps to reproduce. Thank you! 🙏

# ✅ One last step
Click the button below to verify you're human and unlock the rest of the server.
By verifying you confirm you've read and agree to the **#rules**. Welcome aboard! 🎉
-# 🛡️ Admins: review verified members in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/member-origin-role/members/{server_id}).

# ▶️ Claim your Subscriber role
Subscribed on YouTube? Link your account with one click and get the **Subscriber** role automatically.
Sign-in uses Google OAuth — we never see your password, and you can unlink anytime.
-# 🛡️ Admins: review linked subscribers in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/youtube-subscriber-role/subscribers/{server_id}).

# 📺 Link your Twitch
Followers and subs get their roles here — **Follower**, and **Tier 1 / 2 / 3** roles update in real time as your sub status changes.
Link once and you're done — roles follow your Twitch status automatically. 💜
-# 🛡️ Admins: review linked viewers in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/twitch-follower-role/users/{server_id}).

# 🧱 Verify your Roblox account
Link your Roblox account to unlock roles for account age, badges, gamepasses, group rank — even your in-game stats.
Verification is through Roblox's official sign-in — no passwords, no follow-for-proof tricks.
-# 🛡️ Admins: review verified players in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/roblox-player-role/players/{server_id}).

# ⚔️ Verify your Genshin account
Link your UID to unlock traveler roles — Adventure Rank, World Level, Spiral Abyss and region roles are granted automatically.
Set your in-game profile to public first, then verify — it only takes a minute. ✨
-# 🛡️ Admins: review verified players in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/genshin-player-role/players/{server_id}).

# 🎮 Verify your Steam profile
Sign in through Steam and get roles for the games you own, your playtime, achievements and Steam level — automatically.
Verification uses Steam's own OpenID sign-in — set your profile to public so your stats can be read.
-# 🛡️ Admins: review verified players in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/steam-player-role/players/{server_id}).

# 🎵 TikTok creator? Prove it
Link your TikTok account and get creator roles based on your follower count, verified badge, videos and likes.
Sign-in uses TikTok's official Login Kit — takes under a minute, unlink anytime.
-# 🛡️ Admins: manage creator tiers in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://rolelogic.faizo.net/dashboard?plugin_select=https%3A%2F%2Fplugin-rolelogic.faizo.net%2Ftiktok-creator-role).

# 🗳️ Vote for us on Top.gg
A vote takes ten seconds and helps new members find us — and it earns you the exclusive **Voter** role as thanks.
The role expires after a while, so vote again whenever the cooldown resets to keep it. 💜
-# 🛡️ Admins: connect your Top.gg vote webhook in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://rolelogic.faizo.net/dashboard?plugin_select=https%3A%2F%2Fplugin-rolelogic.faizo.net%2Ftopgg-voter-role).

# 🎂 Tell us your birthday
Set it once and the magic happens on the day: a shiny **Birthday** role, plus zodiac and birth-month roles all year round.
Timezone-aware, so your role shows up on *your* midnight. The year is optional if you'd rather not share your age.
-# 🛡️ Admins: see upcoming birthdays in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/birthday-role/users/{server_id}).

# 📝 Fill in the form
Answer a short form to get your role — applications, rules quizzes and surveys are graded automatically and the role lands instantly.
One submission per person — take your time and answer honestly. ✅

-# 🛡️ Admins: build your form in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://rolelogic.faizo.net/dashboard?plugin_select=https%3A%2F%2Fplugin-rolelogic.faizo.net%2Fform-respondent-role), then paste its link over the button's URL.

# 🐙 Link your GitHub
Commits, pull requests, merged PRs and issues — link your GitHub account and the roles you've earned as a contributor are granted automatically.
Works with any public repository — perfect for open-source projects, hackathons and dev communities.
-# 🛡️ Admins: choose repos and contribution tiers in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://rolelogic.faizo.net/dashboard?plugin_select=https%3A%2F%2Fplugin-rolelogic.faizo.net%2Fgithub-contributor-role).

# 🎯 Verify your osu! account
Link your account and earn roles for global rank, PP, play count and accuracy — per game mode, supporter and BN/GMT/NAT included.
Sign-in is osu!'s own OAuth — one click and your rank roles are live. 🩷
-# 🛡️ Admins: review verified players in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/osu-player-role/users/{server_id}).

# 🎥 Link your Kick account
Followers, subs, VIPs, mods and OGs — link once and your channel roles arrive in real time, gift subs and tenure included.
Sign-in uses Kick's official OAuth — no passwords shared, unlink anytime. 💚
-# 🛡️ Admins: review linked viewers in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/kick-channel-role/users/{server_id}).

# 🦋 Link your Bluesky
Followers, mutuals, starter-pack and list members — link your Bluesky account and the matching roles are granted automatically.
Account-age, follower-count and custom-domain roles work too — one link covers them all.
-# 🛡️ Admins: review linked accounts in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/bluesky-account-role/users/{server_id}).

# 🎟️ Got a code? Redeem it here
Enter the code from your ticket, flyer, wristband or invite and the matching role lands on your account instantly.
Codes are one-per-person and some are time-limited — redeem yours early!
-# 🛡️ Admins: create codes and QR batches in the [RoleLogic dashboard](https://plugin-rolelogic.faizo.net/referral-code-role/admin?guild_id={server_id}).
